note: South Sudan: nationals of Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda enter without a visa for an indefinite period; Burundians and Rwandans get a visa on arrival; everyone else applies for an e-Visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of South Sudan
sources.said: Visitors to South Sudan must obtain an e-Visa unless they are of South Sudanese origin, are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries, or are citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Citizens of the following countries may enter South Sudan without a visa for an indefinite period: Kenya Tanzania Uganda ... Citizens of the following countries are eligible to obtain a visa on arrival: Burundi Rwanda ... Citizens of other countries and territories may obtain an e-Visa.
